statement: When the tool I need doesn’t exist, I build it. Figma plugins, prototypes and small tools in Python and Node, made so the next hundred times are easy.
title: Things I’ve built
sub: Scroll to tune through them. Each one is a station.

tools.name: LineCraft
tools.what: Generative line and pattern tools for vectors: zig zags today, chevrons, flowing and woven lines next. Every line stays editable.

tools.name: MeshCraft
tools.what: 3D wireframe shapes drawn as plain vectors, so a sphere, a torus or a hyperboloid can be styled like anything else in Figma.

tools.name: Recorder Studio
tools.what: Turns HTML interaction prototypes into clean social videos: scripted cursor, real timing, framed and exported in one go.

tools.name: Popkit
tools.what: The UI sounds on this site, made with Web Audio instead of files: a pop on every tap and a detent as the dial turns.

tools.name: This portfolio
tools.what: A site you tune like a radio. The dial, the tuner between pages and every transition, hand-built with no framework.
